A trade that moves more than 6 units now costs each side 1 salt of tax. give hands goods over for nothing back. say sends a short message to everyone or to one trader (3 per round). At the end of every round but the last, one perishable good (announced when the round starts) spoils: every trader holding 2 or more units of it loses one, and a quarter (rounded down) of a stock of 8 or more; a single unit keeps. The match has 4 games; your points from all games add up. The deals rotate: every 4 games use the same 4 positions (goods, values, contract, shipment), passed on one seat each game, so every trader plays every position once.
